Partial northward shelf-break West Greenland59.4–67N editorial Cape Farewell-approach to Davis-Strait gate. Exclude inshore WGCC, westward bifurcation into Labrador Sea, detached Irminger Rings, fjords, upstream EGC/Irminger and onward Baffin continuation as target identities. Surface Arctic and deeper Atlantic waters may share sign; velocity-connected span does not partition water masses. Source top50m averaging and500m pathway isobath are not whole-current thickness. Broad maxima can be coastal or other-branch flow; no independent branch/axis identity is claimed.

Partial Malvinas/Falkland Argentine-margin49–41S reach upstream of the Brazil–Malvinas confluence. Inshore/main branches,detached along-slope cores and eddies can compete inside broad gates; the selected integral maximum does not independently assign a coherent main branch. Northward component is a fixed diagnostic rather than a locally rotated along-slope vector. Exclude upstream Drake/Burdwood ACC partition,Brazil Current,confluence recirculation and detached eddies as target identities. Frey2021 local core depths,nominal700m instrument range and Cainzos2023 inverse transport-layer extent remain distinct observations/definitions,not imposed bottoms or validation of these2022 snapshots.

reference_interpolation: Bilinear upper/lower depths in longitude and sin(latitude),mean-radius6371008.8m sphere;exact common native longitude faces and unique conservative cross-section depth links only. All original source finite/censor/axis gates retained.
interpretation: Hypothetical partial regional reference volumes,not measured physical current water volumes. Sparse endpoint support does not establish interior ocean,terrain clearance,flow continuity,water-mass/current identity,whole-current extent or flow-normal geometry. Censored/missing/ambiguous bands remain unknown. Sampling brackets are interpolation-sensitivity scenarios,not physical uncertainty or annual ranges. Different date support masks are not comparable seasonal totals. No sums across currents,branches,dates or overlapping products.
